column1: # Adversarial-review coverage ledger. Verified by scripts/check-review-coverage.sh,
# which derives the package set from `go list ./...` at run time and fails if
# any package has no row, or if any row names a package that no longer exists.

column4: evidence

column1: #   full-adversarial   a dedicated adversarial pass on this package specifically
#                      (not a package merely swept up in a directory-wide scan),
#                      with real findings or a well-evidenced zero.
#   targeted           a real, citable pass exists but is narrower than a full
#                      adversarial dive — a single-target dispatch, a specific
#                      reproduction attempt, or a fact-finding read for one
#                      question rather than an open-ended search.
#   structural-only    reviewed only to confirm a structural property (e.g.
#                      "this is genuinely generated code, not hand-edited"),
#   none               no package-specific review pass exists. Requires a
#   example                  sample/demo code, not shipped in any build.
#   test-helper              test infrastructure, not production code.
#   main-wiring               thin binary entrypoint with no logic of its own.
#                             instead if a structural confirmation pass exists).
#   uninvoked-but-specified   no production caller executes this code, but a
#                             test elsewhere treats its content as a spec to
#                             check the live system against — uninvoked is not
#                             the same as unused. (Added because migrations/
#                             needed a state the original four could not
#                             express; extend the set again if a future
#                             package needs one this set still can't say.)
#   pending                   genuinely unreviewed, no special status — an
#                             honest gap, to be closed by a real pass.
# A claimed pass (depth != none) with an empty last_pass or evidence is
# rejected by the checker — a citation-free "full-adversarial" is exactly the
# inherited-assumption failure this ledger exists to replace. See
# memory/notes) for how the prior text-match approach got this wrong twice.
